payload.headline: Plan headName collision between cores and doors plans prevents lead start

parts.cause: head_name cuts plan dir to 24 chars to fit within 32 chars ('forgent-' prefix takes 8 chars). Because both plan dirs share the same first 24 chars, head-plan.mjs detects 2 matching active plans and throws plan-ambiguous.

options.does: Rename plans/261119-1730-supervision-powers-doors to plans/261119-1731-supervision-powers-doors and update blockedBy in doors plan.md.
options.gain: Removes ambiguity immediately within existing 24-character budget without changing any code or limits.
options.harm: Changes the planned directory slug for doors.
options.label: Rename doors plan directory to distinct timestamp/prefix

options.cost: 1 directory move, updates in doors blockedBy.
options.does: Rename plans/261119-1730-supervision-powers-cores to plans/261119-1729-supervision-powers-cores and update references in doors plan.md.
options.harm: Cores plan is already marked running and git history already referenced its old directory.
options.label: Rename cores plan directory to distinct timestamp/prefix

parts.recommendation: Option 1: Rename plans/261119-1730-supervision-powers-doors to plans/261119-1731-supervision-powers-doors so both plan slugs differ within the first 24 characters.

scope.allows: Rename plans/261119-1730-supervision-powers-doors to a non-colliding directory slug and update blockedBy in doors plan.md.
scope.forbids: Modifying platform vocabulary limits or starting lead sessions with ambiguous names.

parts.what: Plans 261119-1730-supervision-powers-cores and 261119-1730-supervision-powers-doors share the prefix '261119-1730-supervision-'. Both resolve to headName 'forgent-261119-1730-supervision-'. Starting lead for cores failed with grant-invalid (plan-ambiguous).
